verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments layer for AI agents, not an agent or host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows Skyfire publishing its own MCP server (server role) and documenting how sellers gate their MCP servers with KYAPay tokens. Neither shows Skyfire itself plugging in external MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
